concerns.text: T002 is concrete and executable as written (matminer fetches, checksums, loud failure), but the inherited requirement SC-005/FR-001 names OQMD and AFLOW as mandatory sources; no task input can satisfy 'Band Gap (from OQMD)' via `matbench_expt_gap` (experimental literature data) or 'Thermal Conductivity (from AFLOW)' via `boltztrap_mp` (Materials Project). The verification in T002 cannot confirm SC-005 as specified. Root cause is the spec/plan, not the task — FR-001/SC-005 must be amended to name the matminer datasets, or T002's fetch targets changed; adding tasks cannot resolve this.

T006 runs Wilcoxon 'on per-sample errors' (abs_error vectors), but requires statistical_report.csv to conform to stats.schema.yaml whose `metric_type` enum is only {calibration_error, sharpness} — neither describes a per-sample-error test. The implementer cannot both test per-sample errors and populate `metric_type` validly. Specify which per-sample quantity is tested and extend/rename the enum (e.g. `abs_error`) or redefine the test target.

T004 requires 'pipeline_log.csv conforming to contracts/pipeline.schema.yaml', but that schema defines a JSON object (run_id, steps array, additionalProperties semantics), not a CSV row shape. A CSV cannot 'conform' to an object schema as stated. Either write `pipeline_run.json` (as T003 does) or define a CSV row contract; as written the verification in test_full_pipeline.py is ambiguous.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T002 (metadata JSON) vs contracts/dataset.schema.yaml and data-model.md
concerns.text: T002 writes `data/raw/<dataset_id>_metadata.json` with fields dataset_id, source_url, property_name, n_samples_original, n_samples_used, checksum — these do not match the MaterialsDataset contract (n_samples, n_train, n_val, n_test, features, target; additionalProperties: false). The data-model maps download.py outputs to that contract. State explicitly whether the metadata JSON must validate against dataset.schema.yaml (after featurization, when split counts exist) or rename the artifact to avoid implying contract conformance.

All tasks write outputs to `data/results/` while plan.md and data-model.md place them under `results/` (and metrics as per-dataset `results/metrics_<id>.csv` vs T005's single `data/results/metrics_raw.csv`). T009/T011's path references will be internally consistent within tasks.md, but pick one convention so T011's handoff verification ('every artifact path referenced exists') is unambiguous.
